text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies. There were aspects of
your
training that were rather
informative.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I may have been sharp with you before,
but your
training does have plenty of its
own merits.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I can tell that you're watching your
trainee
closely.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to witnessing your future

endeavors.
